pages.text:
Fieldframe measures electricity in **RF**. One RF is exactly one unit of the loader's standard energy (FE), so any mod's generators, batteries and cables can connect to a **Power Terminal**.

Each chassis has **one** RF buffer. Internal generators (Fuel Engine, Solar Collector) fill it directly; processors draw from it every working tick.

**Hand Crank.** Your first RF, before any fuel: mount it on a side or the top and right-click it with an empty hand. Each turn gives 20 RF/t for half a second, and holding the button keeps it turning (never faster). Turning costs a little hunger. It is slow on purpose: crank up enough RF to run a Heater once, then build a Fuel Engine.

rows: this terminal sends RF to the neighbour

pages.text: All terminals on a chassis share one RF-in and one RF-out allowance per tick (default 512 RF/t each). The **Fuel Engine** burns furnace fuel: a piece of coal gives 16,000 RF at 40 RF/t, and the engine pauses instead of wasting fuel when the buffer is full. Heating one item costs 2,000 RF, so coal goes as far in a Heater as in a furnace.
